title: From Reasoning to Learning: A Survey on Hypothesis Discovery and Rule Learning with Large Language Models
paper_type_zh: 假设发现与规则学习综述
best_for_zh: 研究科学发现、规则归纳或语言模型生成假设评测的读者。
one_line: A TMLR 2025 survey that frames LLM hypothesis discovery as generation, application, and validation.
以溯因、演绎、归纳为框架，梳理语言模型生成、应用和验证假设的研究。
why: It makes the difference clear between producing an explanation and testing whether that explanation learns something reliable.
inclusion_reason: A TMLR 2025 survey that gives readers a full-cycle view of LLM hypothesis discovery and rule learning.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Language models can follow instructions and apply known rules, yet it remains difficult to tell whether they can form useful new hypotheses. This TMLR 2025 survey examines hypothesis discovery and rule learning with LLMs through generation, application, and validation. It synthesizes prior research rather than releasing a new hypothesis dataset or discovery system.

The boundary matters because producing a plausible explanation is not the same as learning a rule that can be tested. A discovery claim should connect observations to a candidate explanation and then to evidence that can support or challenge it. Use this survey to define that full problem, not as evidence that any fluent proposal is a new scientific finding.

语言模型可以遵循指令、应用已知规则，但它是否能提出有用的新假设仍难判断。这篇 TMLR 2025 综述从生成、应用和验证三个阶段考察语言模型的假设发现与规则学习。它汇总既有研究，不发布新的假设数据集或发现系统。

边界在于，提出看似合理的解释不等于学到可检验的规则。发现主张应把观察连接到候选解释，再连接到能支持或挑战它的证据。本文用于界定完整问题，而非证明任何流畅提议都是新的科学发现。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The paper uses Peirce's three-part framework: abduction proposes an explanation, deduction applies it to obtain consequences, and induction tests or refines it with evidence. This turns “the model had an idea” into a fuller question: can the idea explain observations, make useful predictions, and survive validation?

The three parts form a dependency rather than a checklist of unrelated skills. A hypothesis has practical value only when its implications can be derived and confronted with relevant evidence. The framework helps readers distinguish candidate generation from hypothesis use and from validation, so a strong result in one stage is not overread as success across the entire discovery cycle.

论文使用皮尔士的三段框架：溯因提出解释，演绎把解释应用为可观察的推论，归纳用证据检验或修正解释。这让“模型想到了一个点子”变成更完整的问题：它能否解释观察、给出有用预测，并经受验证？

三部分是相互依赖的，不是无关技能清单。候选假设只有能推出后果并面对相关证据时才有实际价值。该框架把候选生成、使用和验证分开，避免将其中一环的强结果误读为完整发现成功。

title: Method
方法
html:
This is a literature synthesis. The survey follows a cycle from observations to a hypothesis, from the hypothesis to predicted consequences, and from new evidence to validation. It organizes existing work on hypothesis generation, application, and validation, while comparing formal and natural-language representations where the literature makes that distinction.

For each primary work, record the observations supplied, the representation of the candidate hypothesis, the consequences it must yield, and the evidence used for evaluation. This converts the framework into a comparable reading record. It also separates the survey's conceptual cycle from study-specific choices about models, data, prompts, search procedures, and checking mechanisms.

这是一篇文献综述。它沿着“观察—假设—由假设得到的预测—用新证据验证”的循环整理研究，覆盖假设生成、应用和验证，并在已有研究明确区分时比较形式化表示与自然语言表示。

对每项原始工作，应记录输入观察、候选假设表示、需要推出的后果与评估证据。这样可把框架转为可比阅读记录，也能将本文的概念循环与各研究不同的模型、数据、提示、搜索和检查机制分开。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Its evidence is a synthesis of existing work and the gaps that remain across the three stages. The official abstract does not show that LLMs already perform autonomous discovery reliably; it says the survey identifies achievements and critical gaps. A cited result should therefore be read together with its representation, evidence source, and validation procedure.

This is evidence about what the literature has attempted and where it remains incomplete, not a single controlled demonstration of autonomous learning. A reported success may depend on whether hypotheses are formal or expressed in natural language, and on how new evidence is defined. Check the primary study before comparing claims made under different validation designs.

论文的证据是对既有研究及其三阶段缺口的综合。官方摘要没有宣称语言模型已经能够可靠地自主发现知识，而是指出已有成果和关键缺口。因此阅读被引用结果时，需要同时看其表示形式、证据来源和验证过程。

这说明的是文献尝试了什么、还缺什么，而不是自主学习的单一受控证明。结果可能依赖假设是形式化还是自然语言，也依赖“新证据”如何定义。比较不同验证设计的主张前，应先核对原始研究。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The paper's contribution is an end-to-end lens that connects hypothesis generation to use and validation. It does not treat a novel-sounding statement as sufficient evidence of learning. By placing abduction, deduction, and induction in one framework, it highlights the missing connections between isolated reasoning demonstrations and sustained knowledge discovery.

Its novelty is therefore a disciplined way to judge scope. It asks whether a method merely proposes candidates, can derive consequences from them, or closes the loop with evidence. This helps readers identify where a reported contribution changes the discovery process and where it inherits unresolved evaluation assumptions from earlier stages.

论文的贡献是用端到端视角把假设生成、使用和验证连起来。它不把听起来新颖的一句话当作已经学到知识的证据。通过把溯因、演绎和归纳放入同一框架，论文指出了零散推理展示与持续知识发现之间缺失的环节。

其新意是提供严格的范围判断：方法是只提出候选，能从候选推出后果，还是能以证据闭环。读者可据此识别某项贡献改变了发现流程的哪里，以及哪些评测假设仍从前一阶段继承。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
A generated hypothesis can be fluent without being new, testable, or true. Formal representations may make checking clearer but can restrict expression; natural-language representations can express richer ideas but make validation less direct. The survey maps these tensions, while the empirical strength of a particular method remains dependent on the primary study.

No representation removes the need to specify what counts as relevant evidence and what outcome would disconfirm a candidate. Formalization can clarify checks while omitting aspects of an intended explanation; natural language can preserve nuance while making the comparison less determinate. Treat these as design trade-offs, not as proof that one representation is universally better.

一个生成的假设可以很流畅，却不新颖、不可检验，或者不成立。形式化表示更便于检查，但可能限制表达；自然语言表示能表达更丰富的想法，却让验证变得不直接。综述梳理了这些张力，而某个具体方法的实验力度仍取决于原始研究。

任何表示都不能免去界定何为相关证据、何种结果会反驳候选。形式化可澄清检查却可能遗漏预期解释的部分内容；自然语言保留细腻性却使比较不够确定。这些是设计取舍，不是某一种表示普遍更好的证明。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Use this survey when a project claims to discover rules, explanations, or scientific hypotheses. It helps specify which stage is actually supported: generating candidates, applying a candidate, or testing it against evidence. That separation is useful for choosing data, environments, and evaluation criteria before interpreting a discovery claim.

Turn its cycle into an experiment plan: state the observations, specify the hypothesis format, decide what consequences should follow, and define the evidence that evaluates them. This makes a discovery claim inspectable. The survey supplies the vocabulary for this plan; the underlying papers are still needed for usable datasets, systems, and evaluation implementations.

当项目声称能发现规则、解释或科学假设时，可以用这篇综述拆解其实际支持的阶段：只是生成候选、能够应用候选，还是能用证据检验候选。这样的区分有助于在解释“发现”之前先选择合适的数据、环境和评测标准。

可把循环变成实验计划：写明观察、规定假设格式、决定应推出的后果，并定义检验它们的证据。这样发现主张才可检查。本文提供这套词汇，实际数据集、系统和评测实现仍需查原始论文。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
Read the three stages as a connected loop, not as three independent scores. For each cited method, identify the observations it receives, the form of its hypothesis, the predictions it must make, and the evidence used to test it. Then note whether the representation is formal or natural language, since this changes what validation can establish.

Add two questions while following references: what would count against the proposed hypothesis, and is the reported result evaluated on generation, application, or validation? These notes reveal whether evidence closes the cycle or stops at a persuasive candidate. They also make it easier to compare studies without collapsing distinct representations and validation settings.

把三个阶段看作相连的循环，而不是三个互不相关的分数。对每个被引用方法，记录它接收哪些观察、假设采用什么形式、必须推出什么预测、又用什么证据检验。最后注意它用形式化表示还是自然语言，因为这会改变验证能说明什么。

追踪引用时再问两点：什么结果会反对该假设，报告的评测针对生成、应用还是验证？这些笔记能显示证据是否真正闭环，还是停在有说服力的候选，也便于比较不同表示与验证设置的研究。

title: Citation
引用
html:
Kaiyu He and Zhiyu Chen. 2025. From Reasoning to Learning: A Survey on Hypothesis Discovery and Rule Learning with Large Language Models. Transactions on Machine Learning Research. https://openreview.net/forum?id=d7W38UzUg0

Use the official OpenReview or TMLR record for the authoritative title, authorship, venue, and paper version. Cite this survey for its abduction–deduction–induction framework and its synthesis of the field. Cite primary work separately for a particular hypothesis representation, dataset, validation procedure, or empirical result, since those are not newly introduced by the survey.

Kaiyu He、Zhiyu Chen. 2025. From Reasoning to Learning: A Survey on Hypothesis Discovery and Rule Learning with Large Language Models. Transactions on Machine Learning Research. https://openreview.net/forum?id=d7W38UzUg0

题名、作者、会议与论文版本应以官方 OpenReview 或 TMLR 条目为准。本文可用于引用溯因—演绎—归纳框架及领域综合。讨论具体假设表示、数据集、验证程序或实证结果时，应另引原始研究，因为这些并非本文新发布。
